sentences.en: The new law facilitates the creation of many new jobs.
sentences.zh: 新法律促进了大量新职位的创造。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to facilitate greater access to international markets.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要促进对国际市场的更大访问。

sentences.en: Offline classes are nice as they facilitate rapport among students better.
sentences.zh: 线下课程很好，因为它们能更好地促进学生之间的互动。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：facil（e）（容易做的）+ it+ate（使…）→使容易，使便利
